decision_rule: Preregistered in wiki/plans/2026-11-01-geva-101-r48-follow-ups-prereg (section 2, R1). One blind batch judges GSTA-167's arm C (both passes) beside #108's none-opus and gstack-opus on the 14 cohort units at the rig pin. Each blocking blocker's value is the share of an arm's passes that FOUND it; PR clusters are the units. R1's decision reads only C-vs-none: R2 runs when C's blocking recall minus none-opus's, the scorer's paired delta, is at least 10 points and arm C's procedure gate passed; otherwise the Review Army and adversarial passes on Opus go to Garry as a CUT-CANDIDATE and R2 does not run. The scorer's NO_LOSS, LOSS and size-rule lines are printed but decide nothing here. C-vs-gstack and gstack-vs-none are descriptive. An arm that stopped, or a blocker recorded with coverage incomplete, gives no decision.
